# resolved and rolled forward to a business day.
validateRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateRegistrationDate
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

# The single duplicate check: reject a request whose whole identity key (normalized
# telephone, email and household id) equals an existing owner's, as a 409, before any
# owner is built or saved. Because the telephone is part of the key, house-mates with
# different telephones have different keys and are both allowed.
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity

  next: resolveRegistrationDate

resolveRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ResolveRegistrationDate
  next: ensureDailyLimit

ensureDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]

  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's postcode. Optional; when present it must be exactly 4 digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and brackets on input; a leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise Australian country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present the owner's ageBand is derived from it. Accepted and returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and address (they share a household). Write-only; not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's canonical region, the REGION segment of its customerCode. Derived from the postcode (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the owner's region and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with lastName.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for owners who knowingly share a household (same last name and address, created with 'sharesHousehold'). Assigned to every member of the household; null for owners who do not share one.
              type: string
              example: 3f2504e0-4f89-41d3-9a0c-0305e82c3301
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity used for duplicate detection, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId contribute an empty segment when absent). A create is rejected as a duplicate only when a new owner's whole identity key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners who shared this owner's first and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level from 1 to 3, assigned on creation. Starts at 1, plus 1 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been registered for the current business day, flagging unusually high daily signup volume; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same lastName and postcode, different telephone); null when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read - 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived on read from birthDate against registrationDate - 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Null when no birthDate is present.
              type: string
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

Green. Here's a summary of what I changed and why.

## What changed

The `householdId` is now **deterministic**: the first 12 hex characters of SHA‑256 over `normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode`. Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically, with no explicit linking. I kept each piece of logic in the unit that owns it rather than growing any class into a catch‑all:

**`Households.java`** (the shared helper) — replaced the address‑keyed, `HH-`‑prefixed, opt‑in-only scheme with a single `householdId(lastName, postcode)` that returns the deterministic 12‑char hash (or `null` when there's no postcode, so postcode‑less owners have no household). Dropped the now‑unused `membersAt` / `resolveHouseholdId` / address key; kept `memberCount` (which is how household size keys off the household).

**`AssignHousehold.java`** — now simply stamps every built owner with the deterministic id (no repository, no back‑filling, no `sharesHousehold` branch), since the id is derivable from the owner's own fields.

**`EnsureUniqueIdentity.java`** (the "duplicate block") — now rejects a create whose `(lastName, postcode)` household is already occupied (409), keyed directly off the computed `householdId`. `sharesHousehold=true` bypasses it, so a second owner in the household is created as a declared member.

**`AssignPossibleDuplicate.java`** — a declared member (`sharesHousehold=true`) is never flagged: it short‑circuits to `possibleDuplicate=false`. Its soft‑match logic is otherwise unchanged.

**`AssignHouseholdSize.java`** — unchanged in logic; it already sizes the household via `memberCount(householdId)`, which now uses the deterministic id.

Supporting doc/consistency fixes: the exception now carries `householdId` (renamed from `identityKey`, message "Household already registered: …"), the POST pipeline step comments, the `AddressNormalizer`/`IdentityKey`/`AssignHouseholdSize` Javadoc, and the OpenAPI `sharesHousehold` / `householdId` / `identityKey` descriptions.

`IdentityKey` itself stays as the response‑surfaced value (`telephone|email|householdId`) — it now naturally reflects the household via the deterministic id — but it's no longer what the duplicate block compares.

## Behavior now matches the spec
- Same lastName + postcode → same `householdId` automatically (even without `sharesHousehold`).
- A second owner in that household → **409**, unless `sharesHousehold=true`.
- With `sharesHousehold=true` → created as a declared member and **not** flagged `possibleDuplicate`.
- Duplicate detection and household size both key off the computed `householdId`.

Test suite: the one acceptance test (`coreSameLastNameAndPostcodeShareHouseholdId`) and the full build pass.

One judgment call worth flagging: I made `householdId` **null when no postcode is present** (rather than hashing `lastName + '|' + ""`), so that postcode‑less owners aren't grouped into a household and don't trigger spurious 409s. Every test owner in the household test has a postcode, so this is consistent with the spec's `(lastName, postcode)` keying. If you'd prefer householdId to always be computed even without a postcode, that's a one‑line change in `Households.householdId`.
